## 2. Verification of Invariants and Named Threat Coverage

### Invariant 1 (Highest Applicable Tier & Closed Classifier) [RWW-001, RWW-002]
- `orchestration_harness/risk_weighted_workflow.py` strictly derives the tier using `_derive_tier` from closed change signals and families.
- Declared tiers cannot be caller-lowered; contradictory `docs_only` / `unmounted` combinations fail closed before admission.
- A Tier-0 metadata profile carrying an explicit review trigger or new authority boundary deterministically rises to Tier 1 or Tier 2.

### Invariant 2 (Pre-Edit Baseline & Stable Semantic Freeze) [RWW-003, RWW-005, RWW-006]
- Tier 1–3 require a pre-edit canonical baseline (`captured_before_first_edit: true`).
- `canonical_pass_fingerprint` binds stable semantic source, schema, policy, and test inputs while strictly excluding volatile artifacts (latch snapshots, receipts, generated closeouts, baton prose).
- Exact semantic freeze hashes and inputs reject any drift or stale pass reuse without valid evidence.

### Invariant 3 (Exact Rerun Union on Post-Freeze Changes) [RWW-004]
- Post-freeze changes take the exact union across all declared change families via `compute_rerun`.
- Semantic modifications mandate focused semantic gates, canonical final profile, and invalidation of earlier verifier results. Non-semantic changes receive only their targeted verification gates.

### Invariant 4 (Review Economy & Parallelism Transparency) [RWW-007, RWW-008, RWW-018]
- Tier 2 and Tier 3 mandate exactly one independent final veto; review stacking and concurrent external reviewers are forbidden.
- DeepSeek mechanical implementation lanes cannot serve as the independent veto.
- Explicit planned vs. actual parallelism is preserved and verified; silent deviations or plan rewrites fail closed.

### Invariant 5 (Threat Coverage, Incidents & Tail Deferral) [RWW-009, RWW-010, RWW-011, RWW-012]
- Full coverage for all named threats (`RWW-001` through `RWW-018`) is verified against passing gates; mutation count remains advisory.
- Minimal typed incident records must precede retries; grouping requires strict 5-tuple equality (`origin`, `category`, `role`, `resource`, `signature`).
- No item with safety, authority, integrity, privacy, atomicity, protected-evidence, or irreversible-effect flags can be deferred.

### Invariant 6 (Deterministic Fail-Closed Envelope) [RWW-016]
- Any mismatch between declared decision and evidence returns `revision_required`. No `pass` decision carries reasons.

### Invariant 7 (Deterministic Non-Mutating Renderer) [RWW-015]
- `render_packet` and `_write` in `scripts/ariadne_risk_weighted_workflow.py` reject writes targeting `AGENTS.md`, `.git`, `orchestration/continuity`, `orchestration/compass`, or the latch across all paths.
- Generated documents are strictly non-authoritative candidate evidence with explicit Brisbane timestamps.

### Invariant 8 (Verifier Preflight & Path Bindings) [RWW-013, RWW-014]
- `scripts/ariadne_verifier_worktree_preflight.py` enforces clean `codex/review-` branch, exact 40-hex HEAD, and worktree containment.
- External serial runners must bind `--repo-root` exactly to the review worktree, preventing test resolution against unintended checkouts.

### Invariant 9 (Serial Pytest Repo-Root Resolution)
- `scripts/ariadne_serial_pytest.py` validates repository root containment with `tests/conftest.py` while maintaining the shared-schema lock.

### Invariant 10 (Closed Surfaces & Boundary Preservation)
- No database runtime, Docker, provider call, credentials/IAM, clinical data, deployment, Pages, or protected ref movement was opened or modified.

---

## 3. Final Determination

The exact candidate commit `51866ce084c33fce600b792c66b180927658ed9e` faithfully implements the frozen risk-weighted workflow reform plan while preserving all hard controls. Zero material defects observed.
